rules.statement: A proctor who misappropriates a sum of money given by a client for the purpose of being deposited as survey fees in a partition action is guilty of malpractice and liable to be punished under section 17 of the Courts Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: The respondent, a Proctor, misappropriated and failed to deposit in Court a sum of Rs. 75 given to him by his client for the purpose of being so deposited as survey fees in a partition action. The action was dismissed because of the failure to deposit the survey fees.
